title: 📊 Daily Report: Thu Nov 26, 2026
text:
Thanksgiving: US markets were closed, so no bots traded and no ticks were expected. CORE QQQ is unchanged (trend ON, month-end close Oct 30 690.49 vs 200d 678.37; $8,238, 48% of the book).

Swing book: equity $17,046.43. Week (vs prior Friday's close base): book +$459.91 (strategies +$1.31, CORE +$458.60). Since the merge: book -$2,974.31 (-14.86%) vs SPY benchmark (Indy) -$1,585.72 (-7.92%), a gap of -$1,388.59. CORE since the month-end-rule switch (Nov 16): -3.02% vs SPY hold -4.22%, so +1.20 pp ahead of SPY; the old daily rule would be in cash (0.00%).

Benched shadow bots: Trek, Rota and Sunny have no real positions still running off. Shadow trades today: 0 each. Since Nov 16: Trek 13 (7 on-time, 6 late), Rota 8 (3 on-time, 5 late), Sunny 5 (0 on-time, 5 late).

Research analyst note (Research, Nov 26): Markets were closed, so nothing to grade. Futures firmed (S&P +0.7%, Nasdaq-100 nearly +1%). Bitcoin touched $61K then slipped under $60K, and spot bitcoin ETFs saw a record outflow of about $453M on 11/25. No changes to ideas or avoids. The AI-hardware avoid stays until the 11/30 close review, and retail holds (BBY, DLTR, TGT, TJX) carry tariff risk. Next: Friday is a half day ending 1 PM; Monday brings MSCI index changes; CRM reports 12/2 after the close.

Desktop shadow: IDENTICAL decisions (0 differences; the box logged only holiday catch-up ticks). Desktop heartbeat 5 min old. Code versions MATCH (20261125-2051-27066a4553c2, updater current). ALERT from parity: the sentiment input file differs between the box and the desktop (the book itself is identical; signals and tuned params match; no config drift). Host flag: Windows reboot pending, and the task only runs while the user is logged on. Freeze cost: today not logged yet (last -0.02), running total -8.25 over 5 days. Tonight's re-seed was staged and pushed (exit 0, valid until Fri 9:25 AM ET).

Change note: The box computer was replaced early this morning; the engine was restarted at 9:09 AM ET on the same code and settings, all tests passed, and no trades were missed.

Claude impact: Latest batch (b20261125-014349) on the CORE disaster stop: the five confirmed bugs were fixed and shipped (applied Nov 25, 7:14 PM ET). The stop is still OFF and not wired in, so trading is unchanged and there is no P&L effect yet. For its improvement ideas, we adopted atomic ledger writes, an outside dead-man watchdog and a daily live-vs-lab fill-gap log; the other two become hiring-gate requirements. Nothing built yet.
